description:
IMPORTANT

This mod is a LIBRARY mod.
It will do nothing on its own and its only purpose is to act as a dependency for other mods that use its features.

About

Konkrete is a library mod used by almost all of my other mods.

Technically, you are free to use this library for your own mods, but there's currently no documentation, so it would probably be a very annoying experience.

Everything important is documented in the source, so make sure to take a look at Konkrete's source on GitHub!
